sentence: This project builds statistical and computational methods that use diagnostic tests to rule diseases in or out.
This project tests whether the human imprinting catalog is incomplete and may cause rare developmental disease alleles to be misassigned.
This project designs and tests a cognitive aid that helps prehospital providers recognize what pediatric patients need and treat them in the field.
This project studies how changes in N-linked glycan metabolism in the brain contribute to Alzheimer's disease.
This project tests whether a gene-therapy vector that makes an antibody-like inhibitor can treat the neurological effects of HIV infection.
This project studies how serotonin in the gut affects pain sensing neurons and visceral pain.
This project builds non-invasive imaging methods to measure tumor metabolism in hepatocellular carcinoma using magnetic resonance imaging and positron emission tomography.
This project combines microfracturing with a scaffold that mimics the cartilage extracellular matrix to help cartilage tissue form.
This project studies how the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway affects breast carcinogenesis and tumor progression and whether this could help treat triple negative breast cancers.
This project studies how the HIV envelope changes shape and cooperates during virus entry into cells.
This project builds a tool to measure and manipulate the function of neural organoids, which are small clusters of human brain cells.
This project collects clinical data and samples from lung transplant recipients and uses machine learning to find biomarkers after transplantation.
This project tests whether an imaging technique can map membrane lipids in tumors.
This project studies a therapeutic that knocks down a gene as a possible treatment for Alzheimer's Disease.
This project builds machine learning methods that use nanopore sequencing of DNA to classify pediatric central nervous system tumors.
This project studies how bile duct cells respond to environmental stress and how this relates to human biliary diseases.
This project studies fungal vaccines and antifungal compounds to understand fungal infections better.
This project combines nanofibers with Tricalcium Phosphate to make a bone composite scaffold that ultrasound can activate to heal bone defects.
This project studies how disulfidptosis, a cell death caused by disulfide stress, works and how it can be targeted in cancer.
